HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately represents all key financial terms found in the source document:

- Agreement date (May 25, 2022) ✓
- Borrower name (Oaktree Strategic Credit Fund, Delaware statutory trust) ✓
- Original credit agreement date (March 25, 2022) ✓
- Administrative Agent & Issuing Bank (ING Capital LLC) ✓
- Assuming Lenders (Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation and MUFG Bank, Ltd.) ✓
- Individual commitment amounts ($150,000,000 each) ✓
- Total incremental commitments ($300,000,000) ✓
- Facility type (Senior Secured Revolving Credit Agreement) ✓
- Subsidiary guarantor (OSCF Blocker Holdings, Inc.) ✓
- Joint Lead Arrangers (ING Capital LLC, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, MUFG Bank, Ltd.) ✓

The memo appropriately notes "N/A" for terms not specified in the incremental agreement (interest rate, maturity date, payment frequency, key covenants) and correctly explains that these details would be found in the original Credit Agreement, which was not provided. This is accurate representation rather than hallucination.

ANSWER: NO
MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo accurately captures all key financial terms available in the source document. The source document is an Incremental Commitment Agreement that references the original Credit Agreement dated March 25, 2022, but does not contain the detailed commercial terms (interest rates, maturity dates, covenants, etc.) - those would be in the original Credit Agreement. The memo appropriately notes this limitation and includes all material financial information that is actually present in the source document:

- Total incremental commitment amount ($300,000,000)
- Individual lender commitment amounts ($150,000,000 each)
- Agreement date (May 25, 2022)
- Original Credit Agreement date (March 25, 2022)
- All party names and roles
- Facility type (Senior Secured Revolving Credit Agreement)
- Security structure and guarantor information
- The fact that detailed commercial terms are not available in this document

The memo correctly identifies what information is missing and explains that it would be found in the original Credit Agreement, which demonstrates appropriate transparency about the limitations of the source document.
